"When this hits a MYSTIC HERO, search THEIR deck for any number of Inner Chi and banish them. Then shuffle." Four things were wrong. The gate was ATTACK_CLASS_IN ["mystic"], which asks whether the ATTACK CARD is Mystic rather than the hero being hit -- the same defect walk_the_plank had. SEARCH_DECK had no way to name WHOSE deck, so a card that raids the opponent's raided its own; it now takes `player`. The card was identified by subtypes ["Inner Chi"], but Inner Chi is a NAME (its subtype is Chi). And the trailing REORDER_REF action:"SHUFFLE" is not what REORDER_REF does -- it reorders a deck by player choice -- while SEARCH_DECK already shuffles at the end, so the clause was both wrong and redundant.

"Any number" is capped at 4, the number of Inner Chi a deck may legally contain; SEARCH_DECK offers a fail-to-find at each step, so the player can stop earlier.
